confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied context, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant, café, and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain because Las Vegas room rates swing widely with event dates and resort fees. The FX value comes from search-result snippets of the RBA exchange-rates page, not an opened page; the 2026-10-16 figure may be provisional, and the snippet's 2026-10-15 value is 0.6955.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general US leisure-city pricing (for example Phoenix and Orlando), adjusted for Las Vegas specifics: Strip resort fees, event-driven hotel demand, and July heat-season room rates. No single named comparable city was verified.
